title: [PrismOcclusion] could not measure a circumscribing radius for vessel 'Serpent(Clone)' — it has no MeshFilter/SkinnedMes
notes: Fix 2026-11-20 by claude (ba3ad0569a): The corridor measured the hull once, when the vessel was bound, and a hull still switched off then measured to nothing for the whole flight. PrismOcclusionCorridor.Publish now measures an unmeasured hull again four times a second and reports only one that stays unmeasurable for three seconds.

sample: [PrismOcclusion] could not measure a circumscribing radius for vessel 'Serpent(Clone)' — it has no MeshFilter/SkinnedMeshRenderer hull outside its skimmers. The occlusion corridor is sized from the vessel's own hull, so it has fallen back to PrismOcclusionConfig.fallbackVesselRadius (6). Give the vessel a renderable hull, or the corridor around it is a guess. Docs/PRISM_ANIMATION.md §4.7.
